TAQA Distribution residential tariff

CategoryDaily power bandElectricity (fils): green / redDaily water bandWater (AED/m³): green / red
Expat — flat20 kWh26.8 / 30.5700 L7.84 / 10.41
Expat — villa200 kWh26.8 / 30.55,000 L7.84 / 10.41
National — flat30 kWh6.7 / 7.5700 L2.09 / 2.60
National — villa400 kWh6.7 / 7.57,000 L2.09 / 2.60

These are the 2025 tariff figures, effective 1 January 2025 and identical to the 2023 and 2024 booklets; no different 2026 tariff has been published. Commercial accounts pay a flat 20 fils per kWh and AED 7.84 per m³.

How the band works

Monthly green band = daily allowance × days in the billing cycle. An expat flat on a 30-day cycle gets 600 kWh and 21 m³. Use inside the band is billed at the green rate and only the excess at the red rate. Then 5% VAT is added to electricity and water, and non-nationals pay a municipality fee of 5% of annual rent ÷ 12.

Worked examples (30-day cycle)

  • Expat flat, 1,500 kWh and 27 m³, rent AED 60,000: electricity 600 × 0.268 + 900 × 0.305 = 435.30, water 21 × 7.84 + 6 × 10.41 = 227.10, VAT 33.12, so utilities come to AED 695.52; with the AED 250 municipality fee the bill is AED 945.52.
  • Expat villa, 9,000 kWh and 180 m³, rent AED 150,000: electricity 2,523, water 1,488.30, VAT 200.57 and municipality fee 625, a total of AED 4,836.87.
  • National's villa, 9,000 kWh and 150 m³: all inside the green band: 603 + 313.50 + VAT 45.83 = AED 962.33, with no municipality fee.

For Dubai bills use the DEWA calculator, and for the northern emirates the Etihad WE calculator.

Frequently asked questions

What is the electricity rate in Abu Dhabi for expats?

26.8 fils per kWh inside the green band and 30.5 fils for use above it. The band is 20 kWh a day for a flat and 200 for a villa, multiplied by the days in the billing cycle.

What do UAE nationals pay in Abu Dhabi?

Electricity is 6.7 fils inside the band and 7.5 above; water is AED 2.09 per m³ inside the band and 2.60 above. The nationals' band is 30 kWh a day for a flat and 400 for a villa.

What are the green and red bands on an Abu Dhabi bill?

The green band is a daily-average allowance at the lower rate; the red rate applies only to use above it, not to the whole bill.

How much is the municipality fee on an Abu Dhabi bill?

5% of the annual rent or the rental index, whichever is higher, collected in instalments with the bill. UAE nationals are exempt for their own home.
